name: options
meaning: Opens on the Splash layout. First window open runs System Startup (app login and session set up). Last window close runs Session On Last Window Close, closes karbon_kontroller and karbon_data and, when not hosted, returns to the Splash (session) layout.
settings:
OnFirstWindowOpen -> script 3 Trigger: OnFirstWindowOpen
OnLastWindowClose -> script 4 Trigger: OnLastWindowClose
minimum version 16.0
encryption type=0 (LEGEND does not decode this code)
OnOpen layout -> Splash (id 2)
keychain access to save password on
require iOS passcode on
hide all toolbars on
default menu set -> User Default (id 2)
